name: Damned soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, holding one small dark stone in both hands close to its chest

poses.stand: standing hunched forward, head bowed over the small stone cradled in both hands, staring at it

idle.action: rocks gently, turning the small stone over and over in its hands and mouthing a count, head bowed

hiccup.action: jolts once as if hiccuping, flickers and looks up startled for a moment, then hunches back over its stone
